tool_input_args.value:
import re

# Parse the CSV from the sales_csv variable
lines = sales_csv.strip().replace('\r\n', '\n').split('\n')
header = [h.strip() for h in lines[0].split(',')]
print(f"Headers: {header}")

# Parse rows into dicts
data_rows = []
for line in lines[1:]:
    if line.strip():
        parts = line.split(',')
        row = {header[i]: parts[i].strip() for i in range(len(header))}
        data_rows.append(row)

# Filter for won deals (all products are Meridian Analytics products)
won_deals = [r for r in data_rows if r['status'].lower() == 'won']

# Calculate total and display details
total = 0.0
print(f"\n{'Deal ID':<10} {'Rep':<20} {'Product':<25} {'Amount':>12} {'Close Date':<12}")
print("-" * 82)
for deal in won_deals:
    amt = float(deal['amount'])
    total += amt
    print(f"{deal['deal_id']:<10} {deal['rep_name']:<20} {deal['product']:<25} ${amt:>11,.2f} {deal['close_date']:<12}")

print("-" * 82)
summary = f"\nTotal Won Deals: {len(won_deals)} out of {len(data_rows)} total deals\nTotal New Contract Value for Meridian Analytics: ${total:,.2f}"
print(summary)
